description: D-MPNN within-metal ROC-AUC on the probe's deduplicated cohort, measured on the SAME folds the probe's XGBoost within-metal column uses. Fills BLK-P1: the paper names the D-MPNN as a predictive-line model but had no within-metal number for it on this cohort.
data_source: MetalCytoToxDB (Krasnov et al., J. Med. Chem. 2026, 69(8), 8838)
cohort: paper funnel (build_paper_cohort, no time window) then collapse_duplicates(tie_rule=active)
fold_protocol: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=split_seed); identical to the probe's within_metal. split_seed=42 reproduces the probe's published folds exactly (paired slice).

dmpnn_arch.model: MaskedMetalCytotoxModel (D-MPNN backbone + 2-way head, padding-masked pooled readout)

xgb_reference.note: re-measured on the SAME folds; the delta is paired

honest_negative.why: Ru is 64% of the deduplicated cohort, so a pooled mean is a Ru mean wearing a 5-metal label. The per-metal table is the unit.
honest_negative.fallback_if_dmpnn_loses: If the D-MPNN lands below the XGB within-metal column, the activity-prediction backbone should be named 'GBDT by protocol' and the D-MPNN restricted to its winning roles (bond head, search value). Written to disk either way.

merged_from_slices.note: One slice per (metal, split_seed); unioned by merge_within_metal_slices.py.  Aggregates recomputed exactly as _run_metal does.
